FFmpeg and FFprobe for macOS Apple Silicon, supplied by OSXExperts.NET.
The binaries report GPL version 2 or later and include libmp3lame and libvorbis.
See COPYING.GPLv2 for the GPL text and manifest.json for archive checksums.

Upstream download and build notes: https://www.osxexperts.net/
FFmpeg source: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html

OSXExperts.NET labels its downloads "for educational purposes only" and does
not provide a matching corresponding-source bundle on the download page.
These archives are available for local development; public redistribution
requires a review of provenance and GPL source obligations.
